TotalRecalls v1.3.0 (Windows x64)

1. Unzip
2. Run TotalRecalls.exe
3. Pick a provider → sign in or paste credentials → export

Gemini: paste a Google Takeout folder/JSON path.
Unsigned build — Windows SmartScreen may warn.
Site: https://totalrecalls.app  |  Source: https://github.com/breakwater2026/TotalRecalls
